_comment: The canonical GitHub label set for every repository this account owns. Data, not prose: scripts/github-labels.sh renders it, diffs it against the live API and applies it; scripts/check-github-labels.sh holds this file to core/schemas/github-labels.json offline. Keep the set small. GitHub's nine defaults are listed so a repository created without them (or one where they were deleted) is repaired; every label that is not a GitHub default carries a one-line _comment saying who depends on it. The per-platform agent:<platform> labels are NOT listed here: they are rendered at apply time from the keys of core/capabilities/platforms.json (see agent_labels), so adding a platform adds its label without touching this file.

agent_labels._comment: switch-dev routes an issue to a platform by the label agent:<platform> (resume-schema.md: Owner). One label per key of the capability registry's platforms object, rendered at apply time; the registry is the only platform list. agent:any (unclaimed) is a fixed member of the set below. {display_name} in the template is replaced by the registry's display_name.

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: This issue or pull request already exists

labels.name: wontfix
labels.description: This will not be worked on

labels.name: chore
labels.description: Maintenance, tooling or dependency work with no user-facing change
labels._comment: .github/dependabot.yml labels every Dependabot PR chore (repo-scaffold Agent C writes the same); it did not exist on this repo until this set was applied.

labels.name: dependencies
labels.description: Pull requests that update a dependency file
labels._comment: Dependabot's own default label; present so a dependabot.yml without a labels block still lands on an existing label.

labels.name: ci
labels.description: Continuous integration, workflows and release automation
labels._comment: Workflow and release.yml changes are R4 under ADR 004; the label makes them findable in review.

labels.name: security
labels.description: Vulnerability, secret exposure or permission change
labels._comment: The security-reviewer agent and the secret-scan CI job report under it; a PR touching auth, secrets or permissions is labelled before review.

labels.name: release
labels.description: Version bump, changelog entry or release tag
labels._comment: plugin-version-bump.md: a manifest bump without a release leaves installed users on the cached copy; the label marks the PRs that must be followed by a tag.

labels.name: blocked
labels.description: Cannot proceed until a named dependency is resolved
labels._comment: start-dev reads the issue's Resume block and stops on a blocker; the label makes the blocked set visible on the issue list without reading each body.

labels.name: agent:any
labels.description: Unclaimed — any agent/platform may pick this up (switch-dev)
labels._comment: switch-dev's unclaimed state and the default label of .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/agent_task.yml; the per-platform agent:<platform> labels are rendered from the registry (agent_labels above).
